```
subject: detail-redraw-race
kind: repair
result: pass
revision: 03d561c
evidence: Repro: 25 runs of the single test with --tb=long alongside a parallel `python3 -m pytest tests -q`; 5 of 25 failed before the fix, all [size1] NoMatches '#related'. Traceback: scripts/dashboard_app.py apply (656) -> paint (682, query_one("#related")). After the fix: 30/30 under the same load; 30/30 alone with the acceptance loop; two full `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests -q` runs, 250 passed each (~270 s). New regression test test_detail_paint_is_skipped_when_the_screen_is_torn_down_mid_render fails without the fix and passes with it. The 20 s timeout variant did not reproduce and was not investigated.
observations: Needs CPU load. The 0.3 s poll fires a load worker whose apply lands as the test ends and the app shuts down. The screen is attached when apply starts; paint awaits Markdown.update, remove_children and mount_all while teardown prunes children; #related is gone when paint reaches it.
root_cause: paint checks is_attached once at the start of apply, then awaits several widget updates and mounts; if the screen is torn down during those awaits (test or app exit, or pop_screen mid-paint), query_one("#related") raises NoMatches inside the apply worker (WorkerFailed).
verdict: pass
claim: paint queried #related after awaits without re-checking that the screen was still alive, so a poll-triggered redraw racing teardown raised NoMatches; re-checking is_attached and #related after the awaits fixes it.
needs_human: false
```
